title: kiosk-display-remote-sleep-allowed
description: Payload for the kiosk remote-sleep-allowed gate topics. Published retained by the kiosk node to renewvan/kiosk/display/remote-sleep-allowed (state), publishing its default (true) on startup if no retained value exists; sent unretained by the dashboard to renewvan/kiosk/display/remote-sleep-allowed/set (command). When false, the kiosk node rejects a remote renewvan/kiosk/display/power/set "off" command. Does not affect the host-local auto-sleep timer.
